description: Protection filter for trading bots: tells whether a Solana address is a serial pump.fun creator (3+ launches in the last 7 days, how often it dumped within 5 minutes, how many of its launches migrated) and/or a wallet that repeatedly buys in the launch block of a serial creator's tokens (launch team). Check a token's creator before buying. Updated hourly. Facts about the last 7 days, not advice.

address.description: public Solana address (creator or wallet), base58

name: botsharper_check_wallet
